$comment: The smallest residential plot each document allows to be developed.
The first size band of a development-control table is not permission to
apply the table to every positive area: each document states a minimum
plot size immediately beside it. Below it, the standard calculation does
not apply, so the engine declines with this clause and gives no values
MPD-2021 and UBBL allow a government-sponsored economically weaker
section scheme to reduce the size further. That exception needs its own
facts (is this such a scheme, and what size does it set); it is named in
Each entry carries its value, its words verbatim, the dates it governs and
a verification block: the engine uses only verified entries unless
ENGINE_ALLOW_DRAFT is set. Where several are in force on a date, the
largest minimum governs and all are cited.

citation.clause: Development control norms for residential plots, note 3
citation.original_text: 3. Minimum size of the residential plot shall be 32 sqm. However, in case of Government sponsored economically weaker section schemes, size could be reduced further.
